d: This is a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales and Alliances teams. Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
As we continue to grow we are looking to hire both Enterprise Sales and Alliances Sales representatives to drive revenue growth and meet our goals.

Our Alliances Sales Directors own a book of business helping to enable Canonical to work with its go to market partners, hardware vendors, software vendors, solutions integrators and distributors and channels. With a fast growing channel business, GSI/SI and Hardware partners, we need to enable, manage and grow business opportunities and drive market expansion alongside revenue growth.

Reporting to the Alliances leadership, you will be working with direct sales, marketing, product, customer success, finance, legal and support as you demonstrate thought leadership, practical skills, and apply your knowledge and experience to help us grow in this critical area.

Our Enterprise Sales Executives own the relationships with our direct customers and are responsible for maintaining and growing relationships that result in mutually beneficial engagements. They help craft solutions that enable our customers to be more efficient, solve more complex problems and walk the path with the customer to get the best possible results.

Reporting to Sales leadership, you will work across either a region or a vertical and you can bring your knowledge of previous customers with you. We are committed to giving customers the most knowledgeable and most competent partners in sales so that we can succeed together.
Location: We have remote opportunities available globally.
Advancing a deep understanding of Linux and cloud software ecosystem, and open source selling models
Experience with negotiating contracts and commercial business terms
Building and owning the strategy and the development of the sales engagements
Growing customers awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu
Delivering on targets, objectives and providing a voice of the partner and/or customer
Travelling both domestically and internationally to drive partnerships in person
Aligning and supporting internal Field teams to identify, support, grow and transact
Working closely with Marketing, Sales Engineering and Product Management to deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner and/or customer
Leading executive interlocks between partners/customers and our own leadership team
q: Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve revenue outstanding results in our technological field
Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, regardless of seniority of current position
Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
Thoughtfulness and self-motivation with results orientated mind set and a high level of personal drive to meet commitments
Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long and more regularly to meet clients and partners as required
x: We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Employee Assistance Program including Health and Wellness platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

r: We are looking for a Senior Risk And BCM Specialist to support the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of Foodics' Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), Business Continuity Management (BCM), and IT Disaster Recovery (DR) frameworks.

In this role, you will play a key part in identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating organizational risks while ensuring business resilience and operational continuity. You will work closely with various business units, IT, Information Security, and other stakeholders to strengthen the organization's risk management practices, enhance its ability to respond to disruptions, and ensure alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and industry best practices, including SAMA regulations.

You will contribute to risk assessments, Business Impact Analysis (BIA), business continuity planning, disaster recovery testing, regulatory compliance, and risk reporting, helping ensure that Foodics maintains a proactive and resilient approach to managing risks and business disruptions.
Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of the company's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework.
Identify, assess, monitor, and report risks across operational, financial, credit, market, technology, cybersecurity, and other business areas.
Maintain and regularly update the enterprise risk register, ensuring risks, controls, and mitigation plans are properly documented.
Evaluate the effectiveness of existing controls and recommend improvements to address identified risks.
Support the development and monitoring of risk mitigation strategies and action plans.
Participate in stress testing and scenario analysis to assess potential business exposures.
Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of the Business Continuity Management (BCM) framework.
Coordinate and assist in conducting Business Impact Analysis (BIA) and Business Continuity Risk Assessments across business functions.
Support the development, review, and maintenance of Business Continuity Plans (BCPs) and recovery strategies.
Coordinate BCM tests, exercises, and simulations to assess organizational readiness.
Monitor BCM action plans and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely implementation and closure.
Identify opportunities to improve business resilience and minimize the impact of potential disruptions.
Support the development, maintenance, and implementation of IT Disaster Recovery plans and procedures.
Coordinate DR planning, testing, and execution in collaboration with IT, infrastructure, and technology teams.
Ensure recovery strategies and procedures are aligned with business recovery requirements, including Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
Participate in disaster recovery exercises and support post-test reviews, documenting findings and improvement actions.
Monitor DR readiness and follow up on identified gaps to strengthen IT resilience.

Support the interpretation and implementation of applicable regulatory requirements, particularly SAMA regulations related to risk management, business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.
Assist in developing and updating risk, BCM, and DR policies, procedures, and frameworks in line with regulatory expectations and industry best practices.
Support regulatory reporting requirements and coordinate responses to regulatory inquiries and assessments.
Assist in internal and external audits, regulatory examinations, and compliance reviews.
Track audit findings, regulatory observations, and remediation plans to ensure timely closure.
Prepare periodic risk, BCM, and DR reports, dashboards, and key risk indicators (KRIs) for management review.
Monitor risk exposures, control effectiveness, BCM readiness, and DR performance.
Maintain accurate documentation of risk assessments, business continuity plans, recovery procedures, incidents, and mitigation activities.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders to promote awareness and ensure effective implementation of risk and resilience requirements.
Support the development and delivery of risk management, business continuity, and regulatory awareness sessions.
x: We believe you will love working at Foodics!
We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in-offices.
We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares.
We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

d: The Senior Systems Engineer – Enterprise Services is responsible for the administration, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based technology solutions across ZainTECH's customer environments. The role ensures the availability, performance, security, and reliability of critical infrastructure services while providing advanced technical support and maintaining operational standards in accordance with customer requirements and industry best practices.

Working closely with customers, technical delivery teams, Project Managers, and other infrastructure specialists, the Senior Systems Engineer supports the full lifecycle of enterprise infrastructure solutions, including deployment, configuration, migration, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance. The role also contributes to infrastructure improvements, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer to ensure effective service delivery and long-term operational stability.
q: 4–6 years of experience in Microsoft infrastructure administration, enterprise systems engineering, or related IT infrastructure roles.
Hands-on experience administering and supporting Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, including user management, authentication, and directory services.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and related collaboration platforms.
Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization technologies.
Working knowledge of Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS) and hybrid identity environments.
Experience configuring and supporting Microsoft SQL Server infrastructure.
Familiarity with Microsoft System Center products and enterprise infrastructure management technologies.
Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, including:
Azure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS): Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, and related infrastructure services.
Identity & Access Management: Microsoft Entra ID, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Azure AD Connect.
Enterprise Mobility & Security: Microsoft Intune, Azure Rights Management, and associated security capabilities.
Monitoring & Operations: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and related infrastructure monitoring services.
Backup & Disaster Recovery: Azure Site Recovery and Azure Backup.
Experience supporting infrastructure implementation, system upgrades, migrations, and technical troubleshooting.
Good understanding of enterprise infrastructure security, system availability, performance optimization, and operational best practices.
Strong technical documentation and reporting skills.
Good written and verbal communication skills in both English and Arabic.
Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
